items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: So I got a job with Lucky Millinder.

ctx.x: So I got a job with Lucky Millinder. Lucky Millinder had a very good band, a great band. However, I stayed there, I think it was three weeks and I got fired, the only time I ever was fired in my life. But Lucky told me I was a great trombone player, I was a gentleman, and he liked me very much, he said, but he was looking for something.
